Companion module for [Clockotron](https://github.com/dlamon1/clockotron), the countdown timer that writes into vMix text inputs.

**Install:** download the `.tgz` below. In Companion, go to **Modules → Import module package** and pick the file. Then add the **Clockotron** connection under **Connections**.

Requires Companion 5.x and Clockotron 1.1.0. No changes to Clockotron are needed.
